question: Guinea Worm Disease (GWD) is an extremely painful ________ infection spread through contaminated drinking water.
solution:
The correct answer is __**parasitic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"parasite" **refers to **an organism **that **lives **in or **on another organism **(the host).
 
• The **parasites**, which might be **minute or visible to the naked eye**, depend on the **host for their food in order to exist**.
 
• Additionally, they can **disperse parasite infections**, which might **result in sepsis**.
 
• **Guinea worm disease (GWD), **is an **infection **caused by the **parasite Dracunculus medinensis**.
 
• **GWD **is **spread **by **drinking water containing Guinea worm larvae**.
 
 
• **Larvae **are **immature forms **of the **worm**.
 
• **GWD **affects poor **communities in remote parts of Africa **that do not have **safe water to drink**.
 
• The **peak transmission season**, which varies from nation to country, is when GWD most frequently happens. GWD can happen at any time of the year.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vital Infection**:

 
 
• Viruses are unicellular organisms having protein-coated protein genetic material, such as DNA or RNA.
 
• The spread of a dangerous virus inside the body is what is referred to as a viral infection.
 
• The viral illness's symptoms are brought on by host immunity-related tissue damage.
 
 
 
• **Fungal Infection**:
 
 
• Numerous fungi that are part of our everyday environment might cause fungal diseases.
 
• The majority of people can regularly come into contact with fungi without experiencing any negative effects, however under specific circumstances the fungi may overgrow and manifest symptoms.
 
• Among them is weakened immune system.
 
 
 
• **Bactrial Infection**:
 
 
• When bacteria enter the body, multiply, and trigger an immune response in the body, a bacterial infection results.
 
• Through an opening in your skin, such as a cut or surgical wound, or through your airway, germs can enter your body and cause diseases like bacterial pneumonia.
